objects.name: CrowdStrike Delivers the Next Evolution of the Agentic SOC
objects.description: Universities need to protect their position in education so that students have an independent pathway to employment AI companies like OpenAI are insinuating themselves into the pathway from education to work. Soon they may claim it entirely, a disastrous result for students. We know that students are using AI at school and at university.
